newsitem.title: FRANCE: KAL uses 747-400F for Paris-Seoul route.
newsitem.headline: KAL uses 747-400F for Paris-Seoul route.

text.p: Korean Airlines (KAL), said it had replaced a Boeing 747-200 freighter with a 747-400 on a scheduled service between Paris and Seoul, effective last month.

"The improved cargo-carrying capability of the 747-400F over the 747-200F enables us to load up to 100 tonnes per flight compared to 85 to 90 tonnes," KAL's Paris-based cargo manager, Christian Prochasson, told Reuters.
KAL operates two weekly 747F frequencies from CDG to Seoul in partnership with Air France.
The other frequency operates with a 747-200F, Prochasson said.
"As far we know, KAL is currently the sole airline to operate a 747-400F at CDG on a regular basis," he added.
